name_en: Shaoxing Keqiao Jiejiegao Import And Export Co., Ltd. (Jiejiegao Textile)
name_cn: 绍兴柯桥节节高进出口有限公司
main_products: Linen, ramie, hemp, tencel, modal, cupro and blended natural-fiber fabrics; beachwear fabrics (micro peach, taslon)
woven_evidence: Its site shows its own rapier and air-jet weaving workshops, and its range of linen and ramie fabrics is typically woven. The site never mentions knit.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company's exhibition news page lists the 136th, 137th and 139th Canton Fairs. It is also on the Shaoxing 136th exhibitor list (code 160Q370, textile raw materials and fabrics).

notes: 'Import and Export' is in the name, but it claims to be a manufacturer with more than 80 machines and weaving workshops. Its address is an office in the International Trade Mansion, Keqiao. Business contacts from its site: jack@jjg-tex.com, +86 13575549483 (WhatsApp).
